description: Temperature and humidity controls are not maintained at acceptable levels within facilities containing information systems.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing HVAC systems, lack of temperature and humidity monitoring systems, absence of defined acceptable ranges for temperature/humidity, inadequate environmental monitoring logs, missing alerts for out-of-range conditions, and insufficient redundancy in environmental controls.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Physical and Environmental Protection
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
